title: docs(adr): amend ADR-0130's 2026-09-22 addendum: merge/override of two packages' same-named body objects is now refused
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32516（PR #32652）契约审查 should-fix 1 与专题红线读 6819900035 finding 1。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32652.

## What

`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md` lines 757-767 (the 2026-09-22 addendum) say `objectConflict: 'merge'` / `'override'` reconcile two packages' same-named objects under the stripped/`'preserve'` shapes, and that "none is refused: a composition that was legal before this change stays legal". After PR #32652, `composeStacks` refuses with `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT` (422) whenever two distinct inputs declare one object name and at least one declaration sits in a package body: the additive nested input, the flat pair under `'preserve'`, and `'preserve'` with a manifest-less sibling. The addendum is now false.

## Acceptance

- A dated amendment under ADR-0130 (append-only; the 2026-09-22 text stays) records the refusal, its three shapes, the error code and status, and points at #32516 / PR #32652 and ADR-0150 D4.
- It names the cells that still reconcile (default-manifest flat inputs; two manifest-less inputs) so the addendum's remaining sentences stay true.
- No code change. `docs/adr/**` is governed: Tier H review by os-zhuang and hotlong.

## 业务理由

谁受益：读 ADR-0130 决定如何组合多包 stack 的开发者和审查者。场景：按 ADR 写了两个包同名对象的 override 组合，结果 compose 直接 422。不做：ADR 与行为矛盾，审查以错误前提放行或驳回。

## 读者

docs/ADR 维护者，PR #32652 合并后；起点 ADR-0130 :757-767 与 PR #32652 的 changeset。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue ADR-0130 objectConflict refused` → 0 open hits; #32516 is the code card. No duplicate.
